name: teledrive
description: Single-owner, unlimited-storage file explorer backed by a private Telegram channel

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n telegram,server,web "npm:mock:telegram" "env NODE_ENV=development PORT=8080 TELEGRAM_BOT_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8082 TELEGRAM_BOT_API_DIR=./data/mock-bot-api TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKENS=1111111:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA,2222222:BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID=-1001234567890 ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin12345 npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.mock:telegram: env MOCK_DIR=./data/mock-bot-api npm run mock:telegram -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:winui: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location 'winui-desktop/TeleDrive.WinUI'; & 'C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe' publish -c Release -p:Platform=x64 --self-contained true -o publish"
scripts.rust:build: cd rust-desktop && env PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
